en: A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over dense flat-roofed buildings and domes of an old Middle Eastern / North African city. Several minarets and a church-like tower with a pointed spire rise above the rooftops. The perspective appears to be from an elevated defensive position such as a fort. Printed caption text at the bottom left reads 'ALEXANDRIA from Fort Napoleon – LI.' and a modern-looking watermark with a website URL appears near the bottom right.
